verses.1: A man is a human being.
verses.3: May He who is merciful send you relief.
verses.4: Naham is a beautiful and lovely name.
verses.5: The sons of Yefet were Gomer, Magog, Madai, Yawan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.6: And the sons of Gomer were Ashkenaz, Diphtho, and Togarmah.
verses.7: And the sons of Javan were Elisa and Tarshish, along with their servants.
verses.8: The sons of Ham were Kush and Mizraim. Poot and Knaan.
verses.9: And the sons of Kush: Saba, Wahila, Sabta, Ra’ma, Sabtka. And the sons of Ra’ma: Shaba and Dadan.
verses.10: And when he had given birth to Nimrod, he began to become a powerful ruler in the land.
verses.11: And Egypt gave birth to sons and daughters, as well as sons and women.
verses.12: And also the pots and pans that came out of there, along with the utensils and containers made by the Philistines.
verses.13: And Canaan gave birth to his sons in his own land.
verses.14: And the Yebusi, and the Amorites, and the Gebusees.
verses.15: And the Hivv, and the ‘Arki, and the Sini.
verses.16: And the arwadi, and the tsamari, and the chamati.
verses.17: The sons of Shem were Elam, Ashur, Arpacshad, Lud, Aram, Uzzah, Chal, Gathar, and Meshech.
verses.18: And Arpachshad begot Shelah, and Shelah begot Esau.
verses.19: And two sons were born to him. The name of the first son was Pelag, because in those days the land was divided into separate regions. And the name of his brother was Yaktan.
verses.20: And the child will be smaller than his brothers, and he will be smaller than his sisters. He will also be smaller than his cousins.
verses.21: And Edom, and Uzal, and Diklah.
verses.22: And Eibal, and Abimalek, and Shav’ah.
verses.23: And Ophir, and Chivila, and Yovav – all these are the sons of Yaktan.
verses.28: The sons of Abraham were Isaac and Ishmael.
verses.29: These are the daughters of Kor Yishmael: Neboyot, Kedar, Adbeel, and Mibsham.
verses.30: Mishma and Duma carry a heavy load; they must bear it together.
verses.31: These are the sons of Ismael.
verses.32: And the sons of Keturah were Pelagsh, Abraham had sons named Zimran, Yaakovshan, Madian, and Midian. Also, Yakovshan’s sons were Shaba and Dedan.
verses.33: And the sons of Midian were Epha, Yefeh, Hanokh, Abidah, and Elda’ah. All these were the sons of Keturah.
verses.34: And Abraham gave birth to Isaac. And from Isaac, Isaac gave birth to Jacob and Israel.
verses.35: The sons of Esau were Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeuush, and Yaalam.
verses.36: The sons of Eliphaz: Timan, Omar, Tzafi, and Gatam Kanz, Tamna’a, and Amalek.
verses.37: The children of Reuael were blessed with great wealth and prosperity.
verses.38: And the sons of Seir: Lotan, Shuvah, Zibon, Anah, Dison, and Ezer.
verses.39: And the sons of Lotan were Chori and Homa. Lotan’s sister was Timna.
verses.40: The sons of Shobal: Alian, Manachat, Eivol Shephi, Onam, and the sons of Zebulun: Aya, and Anah.
verses.41: The sons of Anah: Dishon, and the sons of Dishon: Hamran, Eshban, Yithran, and Khran.
verses.42: In the children of Ezer, there is destruction and chaos. The children of Dishon are also in chaos and destruction.
verses.43: And these were the kings who ruled over the land of Edom before the king of Israel, Bela son of Beor. And the name of his city was Dinhavah.
verses.44: And Balak died. Yovav, son of Zerach, became his successor as king.
verses.45: And Yovav died. And Husham became king after him from the land of Timnah.
verses.46: And Husham died. His son, Hadad, became king after him. Hadad killed Midian in the field of Moab. The name of his city was Avit.
verses.47: And they both died. Then Shamlah from Masrekah became their king.
verses.48: And Shamlah died, and Shaul became king over him from the banks of the river.
verses.49: Shaul died, and Hanan son of Akbor became his king.
verses.50: And Hanan’s husband died. Then Hadad became king. The name of his city was Pai and the name of his wife was Mehetabel, daughter of Matred, daughter of Meah.
verses.51: And they died together. They became aluf of Adam. Aluf of Timna. Aluf of Elon. Aluf of Yitet.
verses.52: One Aholibama, one Ela, one Pinoon.
verses.53: One hundred Kenazs, one hundred Timans, and one hundred Mibtsars.
verses.54: One thousand Magdiel, one thousand their cities. These are the cities of Edom.
